decision: One pinned-daemon Status RPC is authorized as bounded diagnosis; full daemon/owner identity and executable gates precede it, same identities are rechecked after.
server_behavior_disclosure: The existing daemon polls first and may reap/teardown an already-exited child; Status may run ip netns pids and nsenter getprop. Client requests no Start, Stop, Restart, WaitReady or Launch. Internal server child counts are not independently qualified.
